description: One wiki page whole: its title, blocks, metadata, version and how many revisions it has. Pass its version as base_version when you save it back.

path.description: The page's address on the site: the wiki's own path for its home page ("" on a wiki of the whole site), a category's path for its hub, else <category path>/<slug>, all under the wiki's path

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: read_wiki_page
title: Read a wiki page
